cohort: 61 pregnant women with laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 (20 asymptomatic and 41 symptomatic)
finding: While the primary Cesarean section rate was higher in symptomatic COVID-19 pregnant women, overall maternal, perinatal, and neonatal outcomes were similar between asymptomatic and symptomatic groups.
mod_finding: The rate of primary Cesarean section was more than twice in the symptomatic group (51.2%) than that of the asymptomatic group (20%).
birth_weight: Measured, no significant difference between groups
